fusions.name: Lingering Reek
fusions.desc: Exhales a cone of reek 6 tiles long that deals 3 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 35% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stinkhorn Lob
fusions.desc: Lobs a stinkhorn at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for every affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Warning Odour
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 30% for 8 seconds and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Retorting Spores
fusions.desc: When you take non-fire damage, a spore bolt hits the nearest enemy within 4 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 8 seconds.
